EXPLANATORY parallel
keys and keyways

NOTE

keys and keyways were formerly covered in IS: 2048-1975 ` Specification for parallel ( first revision 1 `. However, parallel keys and keyways meant for machine tools were covered in IS : 2710-1975 ` Specification for parallel keys and keyways for machine tools ( first revision ) `. The dimensions and tolerances of keys of sizes 4 x 4 to 40 X 22 covered in IS: 2048-1975 were exactly the same as those covered in IS : 2710-1975. which specification was applicable to Only the range of key lengths and dimensions of keyways differed for machine tool machine tools. applications. ln the present revision of IS : 2048, the requirements of keys for machine tools including the In addition, the original range range of key lengths and details of keyway have been incorporated. of sizes 2 x 2 to 100 x 50 as also the types A to J have been retained. This version of the standard ( IS : 2048-1983 ) shall supersede IS : 2710-1975 after its publications. 7
